key_insight: GLOBE turns rank-based feedback into an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors for optimizing product listings in generative search.
engineering_relevance: Reusable optimization memory offers a more inspectable alternative to monolithic prompts, with moderation and deactivation mechanisms to limit harmful updates.
method: An Editor applies relevant handbook behaviors to product listing fields.
A Reflector converts rank-based feedback into proposed behavior updates.
A Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains over monolithic prompt optimization, further improvements from feedback-driven evolution and moderation, and transfer to unseen product categories, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Deployment should verify that rank-based feedback reliably reflects optimization quality before committing persistent behavior updates.
paper_title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
